hypothesis: The frozen counterfactual linear action-value question policy can improve the audited shallow-metadata GBDT continuation when fitted only on each outer-training complement.

matched_control.outer_model_rule: For each outer fold, select rounds on the next frozen fold inside the outer-training complement, then refit the same GBDT on the complete outer-training complement.

candidate.gbdt: Exactly the matched fold-local shallow_metadata_depth3 model; no GBDT parameter or feature change.
candidate.action_space: official legal remaining attributes, other, and absorbing stop
candidate.training_rule: For outer fold k, collect fixed-trajectory counterfactual outcomes and fit action values using only adaptive_sample_ids minus outer_folds[k], with the matched fold-k GBDT as the frozen continuation.
candidate.evaluation_rule: Evaluate the fitted policy once on unseen outer_folds[k] with the same matched fold-k GBDT.
candidate.question_action_continuation: Take the counterfactual action once, then resume the fixed absolute-turn question sequence on the next turn.
candidate.stop_continuation: Absorbing: ask_attribute remains null on every later turn.

diagnostics: same fold-local GBDT with no questions
decision_rule: Promote only if every declared gate passes. Otherwise park the interaction without altering the audited GBDT champion candidate.
